_comment: Field names for which CloudStack 4.23.0.0 defines label.<field> in its own ui/public/locales/en.json. Recorded from a live server; refresh deliberately, the way fixtures in tests/fixtures are.
_comment_args: `args` holds the action-argument names for which CloudStack 4.23.0.0 defines label.<arg>. A dialog field's label is $t('label.' + field.name) with no override available, so an argument CloudStack has no word for needs a bare key of ours — the one place the label.ai.* rule cannot hold.
